title: Measurement
description: Class 5 IMO — Measurement: advanced conversions across length, weight and capacity, operations on mixed units, and basic speed-distance-time word problems.

topics.title: Advanced Conversions
topics.concept:
Units link in steps. For length, 1 km = 1000 m and 1 m = 100 cm, so 1 km = 1,00,000 cm. For weight, 1 kg = 1000 g and 1 g = 1000 mg. For capacity, 1 L = 1000 mL.

To change a bigger unit to a smaller one, multiply; to change a smaller unit to a bigger one, divide.

examples.problem: How many centimetres are there in 1 km?

recap: Bigger to smaller: multiply. Smaller to bigger: divide.

topics.title: Operations with Mixed Units
topics.concept: To add or subtract mixed units, work on each unit separately and regroup when needed. For 2 km 500 m + 1 km 600 m, the metres make 1100 m = 1 km 100 m, so the total is 4 km 100 m.
recap: Work on each unit separately, regrouping when needed.
1000 m makes 1 km; 1000 g makes 1 kg; 1000 mL makes 1 L.

quiz.explanation: 50 + 70 = 120 cm = 1 m 20 cm, so total 4 m 20 cm.
Borrow: 2 L 1200 mL − 1 L 500 mL = 1 L 700 mL.

topics.title: Speed, Distance & Time
topics.concept:
Speed tells how fast something moves: speed = distance ÷ time. A car going 100 km in 2 hours travels at 100 ÷ 2 = 50 km/hr.

We can rearrange this: distance = speed × time, and time = distance ÷ speed.

examples.problem: A car covers 120 km in 3 hours. What is its speed?
A car travels at 60 km/hr for 2 hours. How far does it go?

recap: distance = speed × time; time = distance ÷ speed.

quiz.q: A bus covers 150 km in 3 hours. What is its speed?
A car travels at 40 km/hr for 4 hours. How far does it go?

questions.q: Which is the odd one out (three measure capacity)?
questions.explanation: kg measures weight; the others measure capacity.

questions.q: A train covers 200 km in 4 hours. What is its speed?
A train travels at 60 km/hr for 3 hours. How far does it go?
A rope is 4 m 50 cm and another 3 m 75 cm. Joined, how long are they?
A tank holds 5 L. 2 L 400 mL is used. How much is left?
A cyclist covers 90 km in 3 hours. At the same speed, how far in 5 hours?
2 kg 500 g of sugar is shared into 5 equal packets. How much is in each?
